Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

He has refused his Assent to Laws, the most wholesome and necessary for the public good.

—Declaration of Independence

Which statement shows how this grievance was addressed in the U.S. Constitution?

options.label: A
options.text: Congress may override a presidential veto.

options.label: C
options.text: The House of Representatives introduces tax bills.

options.label: D
options.text: The Senate may vote to turn down treaties.

notes: The excerpt and answer choices are preserved exactly as visible in the image.
